note: B13 goertzel_bank boundary corpus: frequencies, input rows and expected powers as IEEE-754 binary64 hex words, faults as FaultSet bits. Expected values are the native kernel's (portable fdlibm preparation, frozen recurrence and component finalization); every emitted helper must reproduce them bit for bit. Rows include empty, one-element, endpoint, near-DC, protected non-finite/huge/subnormal/signed-zero inputs, saturation, duplicate bins and full 32-bin banks up to width 512.
